trajectory_summary: This is a low-friction, low-energy-leak call with a warm, already-solar-curious customer who cooperates throughout. The rep runs the verify sequence competently and lands a booked appointment, but leaves two real value-adds on the table: the co-owner (wife) is named but never pulled onto the appointment, and a live roof-replacement-plus-garage-solar cross-sell signal goes unaddressed.

observed_outcome.quote: Yeah. Sounds good. I'll go ahead and get you done for Monday at ten
observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Monday) and time (10 AM) were confirmed as a phone appointment, but the identified co-owner (wife) was never explicitly invited to join, leaving the booking structurally incomplete despite being locked.

bill_anchor_audit.bill_quote: Perfect. Yeah. That's, that's the one. Yep. It's got the, the one month there and the chart.
bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The rep successfully captured the monthly kWh number after several attempts but immediately moved to scheduling ('Last thing we need is just to find a good time') without ever using the figure to build emotional alignment against the utility or reinforce the appointment's value.

interest_reason_audit.reason_quote: I've always had an interest in solar, and, we've talked about converting our house. I have a, a workshop that I currently have a small solar system in.
interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The customer's long-standing interest and existing workshop solar system was never referenced again — not when booking, not in the close, and not tied into the text-confirmation promise on the call itself.

script_coverage.quote: Hey, Jody. This is Randy with ION. Just got a request. You were looking at solar for your home here in BlueRock.
What got you interested in looking at solar?
just wanted to start by confirming the address we have here.
is there anyone else from the title of the home with you?
Just looking at the home, is that a asphalt shingle roof? What kind of roof is that there?
it says here you guys are doing your electricity with Guernsey Muskegon?
we just need to look at the last twelve months of kilowatt hours.
we do have a new program... All that's needed to qualify is just to have a credit score that's over 670.
is this your first time looking at a solar for this property here, Jody?
I can either send you a text or email so you could get that over to me
Yeah. It looks like we're pretty open on Monday.
Okay. That'll be fine. Super excited to get this out to you, Jody.

primary_coaching_focus.quote: is there anyone else from the title of the home with you? My wife.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The wife is on title and confirmed as a co-owner, but the rep never asks to have her on the Monday call — this is the single most consequential structural gap since it directly risks a stalled or reopened decision at the closer stage.

key_moments.quote: And then I have you done as the property owner here. Jody, is there anyone else from the title of the home with you? My wife.
key_moments.stewart_read: Rep correctly identifies a co-owner but takes the answer as a data point rather than a trigger to include her on the appointment, per protocol.

key_moments.quote: I'm not sure what it's made of, to be honest with. It's not a it's not a shake roof.
key_moments.stewart_read: The main-house roof material was never actually pinned down — customer is uncertain and the rep does not press further or note the ambiguity before moving on, though this matters less here since the planned install target is the garage's metal roof, not the house.

key_moments.quote: With the company. Yeah. So I've looked at... The possibility of just doing it myself, but I I wanna get some ideas of what would cost that.
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer discloses she's researched a DIY solar install and is using this call partly as a cost benchmark against self-installation — a competitive-pricing expectation the rep doesn't probe or flag. Rep's response ('Someone else did it. Yeah. Definitely, don't blame me there') treats it as a joke rather than intel.

key_moments.quote: I know at some point I'm gonna have to replace the roof on my house, but, I wanna keep keep it clean right now.
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer names a future roof replacement on the house — a live cross-sell trigger for Ion's in-house roofing team — and the rep only responds 'Sure. Yeah. Not a problem,' filing it without bridging to roofing.
